name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1846: The First Found stamps have been captured on every chronicle read since v1819 and nothing has ever compared two of them - read as text, stored as text, printed as text. So the ledger knew every find-date in his grail and could not answer which of them were new. The sweep now reads the ledgers high-water mark BEFORE merging and reports every find dated after it. Measured on his real ledger: six finds in the early hours of 08/20 including M avina s Embrace.
